lines.t: The Butterfly's Dance
In a graceful way, like a prayer with wings passing by
The male's bright wings bear tiny scales
A delicate gift of design
He reaches toward his maiden flight
while her soft-colored wings align.
The Lord's grand design brings forth a cocoon
on a leaf where it rests awhile.
It waits for the day when it opens away
And the new wings unfold in style
This quiet season takes just a while
As life is made new within
Then the waiting is done, and the creature has wings
And the journey of flight can begin
From a cocoon to a butterfly
What was hidden now rises and comes
With a language of wonder beyond our own
A song that creation becomes
It is heard in the sweep of them moons
In the hush of the bright morning sky
All creation gives praise to the one who made life
As the butterflies lift and fly
Praise Yahushua, our King
Who reigns on high
Give Him glory forever
Who taught us to fly
Praise Yahushua our King
Who reigns on high
Give Him glory forever
Who taught us to fly
Who taught us to fly
